cohort_definition: All 250 publicly downloadable cases in pinned Zenodo record14879605; external frozen-model evaluation; not full1073 or official held-out198

model.selected_using: AirRC validation only; no HiPaS model selection or fine-tuning

source_gt: Separate binary artery and vein NPZ references; originals unchanged

overlap.rule: artery priority per explicit author recommendation in GitHub issue #10; original binary NPZs unchanged

space.spacing: Per-case XYZ Resolution from original metadata.xlsx
space.interpretation: Canonical shared LPS benchmark frame, not recovered patient-world geometry
space.prediction_export: Existing nnU-Net inverse preprocessing to reference grid; same shape/spacing/origin/direction required

intensity: Actual NPZ is raw HU; no normalized-example inverse conversion

metrics.skeleton: scikit-image0.21.0 Lee skeletonize; legacy clDice unchanged
metrics.hd95: Maximum of directional95th percentile nearest-surface distances in mm; existing implementation unchanged
metrics.av_mcs_note: Cross A/V voxel errors divided by predicted+GT vessel voxel counts; no extra factor2; not asserted identical to author HiPaS code

aggregation.nan_policy: Exclude undefined values only; record separately, never replace by0

empty_mask_policy: Preserve score_class: both masks empty => null metrics; one empty =>0 overlap/precision/recall/clDice and full-field diagonal HD95; none occurred

input_read_recovery.policy: At most3 normal CRC-valid archive reads; persistent errors raise; restage same unchanged original only. No checksum bypass or bulk checksum pass.
